title: Elegant Juicy Greek Leek Spanakopita
description: A herbal and juicy Greek dish featuring leek, perfect for a brunch mood, made with beurre-monte and satvik-friendly ingredients, in the form of spanakopita.
instructions: Preheat the oven to 375 degrees Fahrenheit.
In a large skillet, heat the olive oil over medium heat.
Add the chopped leeks to the skillet and cook until they are softened.
Add the spinach to the skillet and cook until it is wilted.
In a large bowl, combine the cooked leek and spinach mixture, crumbly feta cheese, and beurre-monte.
Layer the filo dough in a large baking dish, brushing each layer with olive oil.
Add the leek and spinach mixture to the baking dish and fold the filo dough over the top.
Brush the top of the spanakopita with olive oil and season with salt and black pepper.
Bake the spanakopita in the preheated oven for 35 minutes, or until it is golden brown.
